# Two-Strike Tactic Switcher

## Core idea
Retries are for uncertainty, not stubbornness. Two similar failures on the same approach mean the approach—not the effort—is wrong.

## Practice
After two comparable failures with the same tactic, switch: different query path, different tool composition, narrower write surface, or smaller verification slice.

Log the failure class and the remedy pattern you will reuse next time—not a narrative transcript.

## Anti-patterns
Identical retries hoping for different physics; escalating verbosity instead of changing method.
